description:
Use this when the user asks which promoters, directors or company insiders bought, sold or pledged shares of Indian listed companies, market-wide or for one company. Not for bulk or block deals by funds; use get_bulk_block_deals.

Returns disclosed trades and pledges by promoters, directors, key managers and designated persons, from BSE's insider-trading disclosures. Omit `symbol` for the whole market, or pass an NSE symbol, ISIN or BSE code. The window is by trade date: `days` back from today (1 to 365, default 30), or `from_date` and `to_date` (ISO, at most 365 days apart). `category` is "promoters" (default), "directors_kmp", "designated", "relatives" or "all". `side` is "trades" (buys and sells, default), "buy", "sell", "pledge" (pledges and releases) or "all". `min_value_inr` keeps rows of at least that value and drops rows with no disclosed value. `group_by` is "trade" (default, newest first) or "company" (buy, sell and net value per company, ordered by total value traded). `limit` is 1 to 500 (default 100). Equity only unless `include_derivatives` is true. Reports for the latest two weeks are still arriving.
name: get_insider_trades
title: Promoter and insider trades
